caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different model configurations during Whisper fine-tuning. The x-axis is labeled “epoch” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “WER” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  

The first line, representing “tiny AdaLoRA_int4”, is black with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at approximately 68 at epoch 0 and ending at approximately 38 at epoch 6. The second line, representing “tiny int4”, is dark grey with circular markers and a dashed line style, starting at approximately 64 at epoch 0 and concluding at approximately 41 at epoch 6. The third line, representing “tiny int8”, is light grey with square markers and a dashed line style, initiating at approximately 54 at epoch 0 and ending at approximately 33 at epoch 6. Finally, the fourth line, representing “tiny full”, is dotted and also light grey in color, starting at approximately 30 at epoch 0 and rising to approximately 39 at epoch 6.
